visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts in a real-life retail environment with a close-up of a convenience store shelf. A variety of colorful card packages are hanging on hooks. The central focus is a green and white miniature ATM-shaped keychain card in plastic packaging with CTBC BANK and icash2.0 logos. The lighting is bright and industrial. (2) The scene cuts to a mahjong table with purple and white tiles. A hand holds the packaged card over the tiles. The background is a domestic room with soft indoor lighting. (3) A young man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a grey t-shirt with a Buzz Lightyear graphic, is shown from the chest up at the mahjong table. He smiles while holding the miniature ATM card. (4) A close-up shows the man's hands tapping the miniature ATM card against the back of a black smartphone. The tiny screen on the ATM device lights up with a yellow glow. Mahjong tiles are visible in the foreground. (5) The final shot is a close-up of the miniature ATM card standing on the table, rotating slowly. It features a cartoon chick character and various small details.
